item.title: Longford and Roscommon record hurling league wins
item.description: Longford overcame Monaghan to make it three wins from three in the Allianz hurling league division four played at Cloghan. Joe Rabbit, Martin Farrell and Reuben Murray points helped Monaghan into a six point lead after 23 minutes, Longford lading eight points to two. Monaghan were reduced to 14 players on the stroke of half-time when James Brady was shown a red card. Longford took a nine point lead to the break, 12 points to three. item.description: People Before Profit doesn't want the Taoiseach to meet Donald Trump in the US at all. Micheál Martin is planning to visit President Trump at the White House on St. Patrick's Day. item.title: Local TD urging state to be considerate with unqualified elderly drivers
item.description: A Roscommon-Galway TD is urging the state to be considerate with elderly people who aren't fully qualified to drive. Almost 69,000 people have held three or more learner permits without passing a driving test. But, from November, new rules will require unqualified drivers seeking a third or subsequent permit to do the entire learning process again - if a test has not been taken within the previous two years. item.title: Over 3,600 cars failed NCT test across region so far this year
item.description: Over 3,600 cars failed the NCT in the Shannonside Northern Sound region in the first month of this year. The statistics were made available on the official NCT website. Just over 7,000 tests were carried out in Carrick-on-Shannon, Castlerea, Longford, Cavan and Monaghan in January. Castlerea had the highest pass rate in the region at 50.31% That was followed by Monaghan at 49.86% and Carrick-on-Shannon at 49.10%. Across all three centres there were 500 dangerous failures. item.title: Athlone Chamber CEO backs plans to turn town into 'green city'
item.description: The CEO of Athlone Chamber says they're backing plans to turn the town into a green city by 2040. Developer Sean Mulryan and Ballymore made a presentation at last month's Roscommon County council meeting. item.title: Longford clinch opening league victory at the death
item.description: A last minute Daniel Reynolds goal saw Longford claim an opening league win over Waterford in Dungarvan. Matthew Carey and Paddy Moran got Longford’s opening points of the day as both sides exchanged scores after a cagey start. Waterford were reduced to 14 men for 10 minutes when Liam Mulligan was shown a black card.
